note: Every input of the Windows payload that is not this repository's own committed source. The builder refuses an interpreter archive whose SHA-256 differs from archive_sha256 and a uv that reports a version other than installer.version (it checks the version uv reports, not the binary; the binary is pinned by hash where it is installed from build-tools.txt), and it downloads nothing itself; the archive is fetched by whoever runs the build (CI's rebuild job, or an operator) and checked against archive_sha256 before it is opened.
